home.rietiDesc: On behalf of ACI Sport I created video footage both from the ground, with camera and gimbal, and aerial with drone in an urban environment. In addition, I handled the live streaming service with stabilized drone and in FPV mode, with a production that was broadcast live on Sky, offering the public and organizers dynamic and immersive images of the entire competition.
home.gubbioTitle: Official video coverage Luigi Fagioli Trophy
home.gubbioDesc: On behalf of ACI Sport I created the official video footage of the Luigi Fagioli Trophy in Gubbio, both from the ground, with camera and gimbal, and aerial with drone in an urban environment. I also handled the live streaming service with stabilized drone and FPV, allowing the live broadcast of the event on Sky. The images told the race in a dynamic and immersive way, enhancing every moment of the competition.
home.ericeTitle: Official video coverage 67th Monte Erice Hill Climb
home.ericeDesc: On behalf of ACI Sport I created the official video footage of the Monte Erice Hill Climb, with ground footage using camera and gimbal and aerial footage with drone in urban areas and on the race course. I handled the live streaming service with stabilized drone and FPV, allowing the live broadcast of the entire event on Sky. This hill climb, different from the supersalita in terms of race type, was told through dynamic and immersive images, enhancing landscapes and competitive moments of the competition

about.title: ABOUT ME
about.intro: Hi! I'm Andrea, aka Mindalist, a drone pilot, videographer, and video editor based in Tuscany. My passion for imagery and motion led me to turn my interest in technology and creativity into a profession. I specialize in aerial filming, creating unique, high-impact visual content for various industries—ranging from promotional videos and events to documentaries and film projects.
about.description: In addition to flying professional drones, I also build custom-made drones, tailored for specific and dynamic shoots. As a videographer and video editor, I transform footage into engaging stories, taking care of every post-production detail to ensure a high-quality result
about.creativityDesc: I combine an artistic vision with mastery of technology to create extraordinary content.
about.experienceDesc: Years of experience in the sector allow me to offer a precise and reliable service.
about.innovationDesc: My passion for custom-built drones allows me to create exclusive and tailor-made footage for every project.

videomaking.heroSub: Breathtaking aerial footage with FPV and stabilized drones, combined with professional ground filming to create impactful visual content.
videomaking.comparisonDesc: Compare raw footage with the final result: every project is crafted for maximum visual impact.
videomaking.featuresDesc: A complete service from pre-production to delivery of the finished product.
videomaking.feat1Desc: Dynamic and immersive sequences with custom FPV drones, ideal for sports, events and high-impact content.
videomaking.feat2Desc: Smooth, professional cinematic footage with stabilized drones for corporate videos, real estate and documentaries.
videomaking.feat3Desc: Aerial and ground footage with camera and gimbal for complete 360° coverage of your event or project.
videomaking.feat4Desc: Real-time drone live streaming service, perfect for sporting events, concerts and conferences.
videomaking.reelDesc: Every project is a new creative challenge. From concept to delivery, I handle every phase: flight planning, aerial and ground filming, and complete post-production.
videomaking.phoneSub: The best aerial and ground footage.

postProduction.heroSub: I transform your raw footage into visual masterpieces through professional editing, cinematic color grading and sound design.
postProduction.comparisonDesc: Color grading completely transforms the atmosphere and emotion of every frame, giving your video a unique and professional look.
postProduction.featuresDesc: Every project follows a professional workflow to guarantee the highest quality results.
postProduction.feat1Desc: Color correction and cinematic grading to give your video a professional look consistent with your creative vision.
postProduction.feat2Desc: Precise, narrative editing that tells your story in an engaging way, with rhythm and transitions studied down to the smallest detail.
postProduction.feat3Desc: Animated titles, custom graphics and visual effects to enrich your videos and make them memorable.
postProduction.feat4Desc: Music selection, audio mixing and sound design to complete the visual experience with impeccable audio.
postProduction.showcaseDesc: Every post-production project is unique. From color correction to final editing, I take care of every detail to guarantee a result that exceeds your expectations.
